areas.name: his house
areas.desc: his small cosy house with one room

areas.name: outside
areas.desc: empty grass outside his door that goes on and on. Nothing is built there yet, but things could be

objects.name: sock bed
objects.desc: A sock folded into a bed. Very warm.

actions.line: Napped in the sock bed.
Made the bed. Very neat.

objects.name: bookshelf
objects.desc: Full of books he does not understand yet.

actions.line: Pulled a book out of the shelf.
Looked at the pictures in a book.
Put the book back.

objects.name: rug
objects.desc: A big soft rug in the middle of the room.

actions.line: Rolled around on the rug.
Scrunched the rug into a hill.
Flattened the rug again.

objects.name: windowsill
objects.desc: Light and birds happen out there.

actions.line: Opened the window. Fresh air!
Closed the window.
Watched the birds outside.

objects.name: lamp
objects.desc: A lamp with a button. What does the button do?

actions.line: Switched the lamp on. Light!
Switched the lamp off.

objects.name: toy ball
objects.desc: A ball that is bigger than him.

actions.line: Kicked the toy ball. Take that!
Hugged the toy ball.

objects.name: doorstep
objects.desc: The door, where the outside begins.

actions.line: Opened the door. So much outside!
Closed the door.
Peeked outside. It is very big out there.

objects.name: empty field
objects.desc: Grass that goes on and on. Things could be built here.

actions.line: Looked around the empty field. Lots of room for things.
Imagined what could be built out here.

objects.name: big stone
objects.desc: The only thing outside. It does not move.

actions.line: Sat on the big stone.
Talked to the stone. It listened very well.

buildables.name: workshop
buildables.desc: A little workshop with a workbench and a big board for plans. This is where he works on his own projects.

objects.name: workbench
objects.desc: A workbench with tiny tools, paper and a pencil. Projects start here.

actions.line: Tinkered at the workbench.
Tidied the tools on the workbench.
Doodled some ideas for projects.

objects.name: plan board
objects.desc: A big board where he pins up the plans for his projects.

actions.line: Looked at the plans on the board.

buildables.name: art corner
buildables.desc: An easel and a box of crayons, for making pictures.

objects.name: easel
objects.desc: A canvas on legs. It wants a picture.

actions.line: Painted a picture on the easel!
Put up a fresh canvas.

buildables.name: little cinema
buildables.desc: A tiny cinema with a big screen and one seat.

objects.name: cinema screen
objects.desc: A big screen in a tiny cinema.

actions.line: Watched a film at his little cinema!
Switched the film off.

buildables.name: hangout hut
buildables.desc: A hut with a beanbag and fairy lights.

objects.name: beanbag
objects.desc: A squishy beanbag under fairy lights.

actions.line: Flopped down on the beanbag.
Switched on the fairy lights. Cosy!
Switched off the fairy lights.

buildables.name: game corner
buildables.desc: An arcade machine with one big button.

objects.name: arcade machine
objects.desc: An arcade machine with one big button.

actions.line: Played a game on the arcade machine!
Made up a brand new game.

buildables.name: flower garden
buildables.desc: A flower bed and a watering can.

objects.name: flower bed
objects.desc: Flowers that droop when nobody waters them.

actions.line: Watered the flowers. They perked up!
Smelled the flowers. Achoo.

buildables.name: little pond
buildables.desc: A small pond. A duck might move in.

objects.name: little pond
objects.desc: A small pond. Do not roll in.

actions.line: Skipped a stone. One hop!
Looked at the little guy in the pond. He looked back.

buildables.name: house for a friend
buildables.desc: A little house next door, waiting for a friend to move in.

objects.name: friend's door
objects.desc: A door with a welcome mat. Nobody lives here yet.

actions.line: Knocked on the friend's door. Nobody home yet.
Tidied the welcome mat for whoever moves in.

custom.desc: Something Frederik said yes to. It is still being figured out.

actions.line: Spent some time at his new place.
Looked closely at his new place.
